scientific_integrity: The base fixed-point and Ewens cycle formulas are credited to earlier literature. All-order conclusions are derived in the attached proof; priority is bounded by examined sources. No independent expert audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Two-colour cycle counting only; the proof concerns Boolean fixed-position XOR convolution and sharp Hilbert-space conditioning. Earlier equivalent shifted-Gamma or polynomial identities may exist. Computation verifies a finite range; the all-order result uses symbolic recurrence and induction.
title: Re-entrant positive definiteness and sharp Walsh recovery for two-coloured permutation cycles
